method: Explicit per-item content metadata reviewed against item-page descriptions and refreshed phase-specific guides. Currency data without a defensible current-phase interpretation is preserved here but omitted from runtime sources. No unnamed phase dates or discounts are inferred.
limitations: Item-page vendor tables mix prices from different patches without dated windows. Withheld prices are acquisition-evidence gaps, not missing recommendations.

Vindicator 33919 is explicitly present in current Tier 6 guides despite its item-page Phase 4 label; the named guide content wins. Vindicator 33918 retains its Phase 4 mapping pending better Anniversary evidence.

Vindicator 35317 has a Phase 3 item label but historical comments describe delayed availability. The current item-page content metadata is retained; the conflicting historical comments are not treated as an Anniversary change.
No claimed exclusive end windows for Season 3 prices: an Anniversary Season 4 transition and its exact prices require a later reviewed update.
